description: A ground-level photograph depicting an expansive area dominated by dense, low-lying sclerophyllous scrubs and bushes, interspersed with taller green grasses. The vegetation is predominantly green, indicating healthy growth. The terrain is gently undulating, with subtle mounds and depressions. In the background, a distinct treeline or forest border is visible, beyond which appears to be a range of hills or mountains under a light, clear sky. This image provides a visual example of the characteristics associated with Sclerophyllous scrubs, including maquis, garrigue, and phrygana, as defined for CORINE Land Cover (CLC) class 3.2.3.
